conversion_policy: Costs are displayed in native provider currency and converted both ways using cotacaoVenda, the PTAX closing sell rate, because USD-native costs are converted to BRL and BRL-native Sabiá-3 costs are converted to USD for an itemized total.
redaction_note: Provider account identifiers, organization/project identifiers, user identifiers, API-key identifiers, and per-key/per-user breakdowns were removed before archival release.
